s.Le métabolisme de base baisse un peu qua: Basal metabolic rate drops a little when you lose weight (about 10 to 20 kcal per kg): that's normal. What matters is keeping your lean mass: if it stays stable while your weight drops, the loss really is fat.

s.Mains sur le mur à hauteur d'épaules, pi: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, feet a big step from the wall. Body straight, lower your chest towards the wall, push. Step your feet back to make it harder.
s.Mains sur un plan de travail ou une tabl: Hands on a worktop or a stable table. Body braced from head to heels, elbows at 45° from the body.
s.Mains sur une chaise calée contre un mur: Hands on a chair wedged against a wall or a bench. The lower the support, the harder it is.
s.Genoux au sol (sur une serviette), ligne: Knees on the floor (on a towel), straight line knees-shoulders. Chest to a few cm from the floor.
s.Position de pompe classique, descends en: Classic push-up position, lower yourself to the floor in 3 to 5 seconds, put your knees down to come back up. Builds strength for the full push-up.
s.Mains un peu plus larges que les épaules: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body braced, chest close to the floor, push without arching your back.
s.Pieds sur une chaise ou un banc, mains a: Feet on a chair or bench, hands on the floor. More work on the upper chest and shoulders.
s.Assieds-toi lentement sur une chaise pui: Sit down slowly on a chair, then stand up without using your hands. Feet hip-width apart.
s.Pieds largeur d'épaules, pousse les fess: Feet shoulder-width apart, push your hips back, knees in line with your feet, heels down. Go as low as is comfortable.
s.Même squat, mais tiens 2 secondes en pos: Same squat, but hold 2 seconds at the bottom before coming up.
s.Pied arrière posé sur une chaise, descen: Back foot on a chair, lower straight down on the front leg. Keep your torso upright.
s.Squat puis saut explosif, réception soup: Squat then explosive jump, soft landing with bent knees.

s.Données restaurées ✓ — l'app va redémarr: Data restored ✓ — the app will restart.
Everything is stored on this phone.
s.Une copie automatique est rangée dans le: An automatic copy is kept in the Documents/NutriMaison folder: it stays even if the app is uninstalled.
s.Fais une sauvegarde avant de réinstaller: Make a backup before reinstalling the app or changing device.
s.Au démarrage de l'app, les 4 dernières s: When the app starts, the last 4 are kept.
s.Les copies automatiques sont dans Docume: Automatic copies are in Documents › NutriMaison.
s.Vérifie une fois par jour (lecture de la: Checks once a day (reads the project's public page, nothing is sent).
s.Tes recettes, des idées, et ta semaine d: Your recipes, ideas, and your week of meals.
s.Pas encore de recette perso. Crée-la ici: No custom recipe yet. Create it here, or save it from Add → AI text, or from a fridge idea in "Ideas".
s.Les plus notées dans ton journal en prem: Most logged in your diary first.
s.Coche ce que tu as : les recettes faisab: Tick what you have: doable recipes first
s.Ajouté à la liste de courses (onglet Sem: Added to the shopping list (Week tab) ✓
s.Coche au moins un aliment pour voir les: Tick at least one food to see doable recipes.
s.Aucune recette de l'appli ne colle : ajo: No app recipe fits: add a few foods
s.ou demande des idées à l'IA: or ask the AI for ideas
s.La garder dans mes recettes pour: Keep it in my recipes for
s.Valeurs nutritionnelles non disponibles: Nutrition values not available for this recipe (external source, no macros provided).
s.Cette recette vient d'une source externe: This recipe comes from an external source (TheMealDB) without nutrition values — so it can't be added directly to the diary. Use it as inspiration, or add its ingredients one by one via manual entry.
s.ingrédients reliés à la table Ciqual: ingredients linked to the Ciqual table
s.Rechercher un aliment ou une marque…: Search a food or a brand…
s.L'appli redémarre pour changer de langue: The app restarts to change language. Your meals, recipes and settings don't change; food names stay as in the databases (in French for Ciqual and Open Food Facts).
